response.original_title: The End of the F***ing world
response.overview: James, a 17 outcast, believes he is a psychopath. The ultimate test to confirm this: killing a human being. He meets Alyssa, a rebellious and rage-filled teenager, who convinces him to embark on a journey to find her estranged father.
response.tagline: Sometimes you realize you've had a moment that's going to affect the rest of your life.
